serviceid.description: ID of the service. Must be defined for each service being updated; all other properties are optional. Read-only; required for update operations.

algorithm.description: Status calculation rule. Only applicable if child services exist. Possible values: 0 - set status to OK; 1 - most critical if all children have problems; 2 - most critical of child services.

sortorder.description: Position of the service used for sorting. Possible values: 0-999.

propagation_rule.description: Status propagation rule. Possible values: 0 - (default) propagate service status as is - without any changes; 1 - increase the propagated status by a given propagation_value (by 1 to 5 severities); 2 - decrease the propagated status by a given propagation_value (by 1 to 5 severities); 3 - ignore this service - the status is not propagated to the parent service at all; 4 - set fixed service status using a given propagation_value. Required if propagation_value is set.

propagation_value.description: Status propagation value. Possible values if propagation_rule is set to "0" or "3": 0 - Not classified. Possible values if propagation_rule is set to "1" or "2": 1 - Information; 2 - Warning; 3 - Average; 4 - High; 5 - Disaster. Possible values if propagation_rule is set to "4": -1 - OK; 0 - Not classified; 1 - Information; 2 - Warning; 3 - Average; 4 - High; 5 - Disaster. Required if propagation_rule is set.

uuid.description: Universal unique identifier, used for linking imported services to already existing ones. Auto-generated, if not given.

created_at.description: Unix timestamp when service was created.

children.description: Child services to replace the current child services. The child services must have only the serviceid property defined.

parents.description: Parent services to replace the current parent services. The parent services must have only the serviceid property defined.

tags.description: Service tags to replace the current service tags.

operator.description: Mapping condition operator. Possible values: 0 - (default) Equals; 2 - Contains.

problem_tags.description: Problem tags to replace the current problem tags.

type.description: Condition for setting (New status) status. Possible values: 0 - if at least (N) child services have (Status) status or above; 1 - if at least (N%) of child services have (Status) status or above; 2 - if less than (N) child services have (Status) status or below; 3 - if less than (N%) of child services have (Status) status or below; 4 - if weight of child services with (Status) status or above is at least (W); 5 - if weight of child services with (Status) status or above is at least (N%); 6 - if weight of child services with (Status) status or below is less than (W); 7 - if weight of child services with (Status) status or below is less than (N%). Where: N (W) is limit_value; (Status) is limit_status; (New status) is new_status. Required.

limit_value.description: Limit value. Possible values: for N and W: 1-100000; for N%: 1-100. Required.

limit_status.description: Limit status. Possible values: -1 - OK; 0 - Not classified; 1 - Information; 2 - Warning; 3 - Average; 4 - High; 5 - Disaster. Required.

new_status.description: New status value. Possible values: 0 - Not classified; 1 - Information; 2 - Warning; 3 - Average; 4 - High; 5 - Disaster. Required.

status_rules.description: Status rules to replace the current status rules.
